checks.corpus: exact generator, shape, ZIP member names, source archive/content hashes and byte counts from candidate/corpus-bindings.json
checks.semantic: independent title/body regeneration, source/output semantic and order digests, text projection and exact one-slide append
checks.zip: source/output member media types, compression, CRC, decoded/compressed hashes, untouched-member raw identity, manifest gates, opaque payload identity
checks.output_fixture: candidate source/output archive bytes, content identity, and member identities are pre-bound by native/verify-output.py; control output is semantic/order/text/count reference only
checks.proof: source slide count, content.xml byte proof, positive insertion offset before source end, deterministic page name, fixture proof scalar validation, and aligned per-sample runtime-proof/report source ID and revision equality
checks.source: read_calls and returned bytes measured; requested byte lengths, largest ranges, request pattern, compressed/decompressed/recompressed boundaries explicitly unavailable
checks.sink: accepted bytes, logical write calls, largest accepted write, and write-size buckets bind to the returned publication output
checks.allocator: allocator mode requires operation-scoped measured vectors and live-byte balance; normal mode must not publish measured allocator vectors
checks.scope: specialized source-backed publication-plan lifecycle; no ordinary Commit/Patch or general CRUD speedup claim
